scope: Macro-board follow-through plus deep adjacent-theme opportunity screen across US, Hong Kong/China and Malaysia. Research/content only; no site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.
verdict: The macro regime still rewards quality physical bottlenecks over financing-dependent narratives. The deep screen produced four new priority research candidates that improve the stack's diversification: Belden for AI/industrial networking, Generac for power reliability, Amkor for advanced packaging/HBM infrastructure, and ASMPT for HBM/photonics/AI-server equipment. Refined-product logistics remains a tactical satellite theme rather than a core compounder sleeve. No genuinely new Malaysia core name clears the bar today.

macro.regime: Industrial/power capex remains strong while long-duration financing is restrictive. Broad high-yield credit remains benign for stronger borrowers, but stress is concentrated in weaker credits, so the admission filter stays focused on backlog, cash conversion and manageable leverage.
macro.rates: 10Y/30Y Treasury yields remain around the 4.7%/5.25% area, keeping valuation discipline central for AI, grid, advanced packaging and robotics names.
macro.energy: Crude has eased from recent highs, but refined-product scarcity remains the stronger physical signal. Asian middle-distillate availability and shipping disruption support a tactical product-tanker/logistics screen.
macro.fx: USD/MYR near 4.04 is not a thesis-changing headwind for Malaysian electrical/automation names.

newPriorityResearch.theme: AI/data-centre connectivity + industrial networking + physical AI
newPriorityResearch.reason: Best fresh US quality/valuation combination. Record Q2 orders and book-to-bill show data-centre/industrial networking demand is converting into current business while valuation is less duration-sensitive than many optical leaders.

Direct hyperscaler backlog validates the reliability-around-the-bottleneck thesis. The remaining work is to separate the high-quality C&I/data-centre growth from residential cyclicality and capacity-ramp risk.
NVIDIA prepayment and the 10-year TSMC partnership validate packaging/test capacity as infrastructure. Rank below BDC/GNRC because current capex and free-cash-flow risk are materially higher.

newPriorityResearch.theme: HBM TCB/hybrid bonding + photonics + AI-server SMT
newPriorityResearch.reason: Strongest genuinely new Hong Kong/China candidate because it touches three AI bottlenecks at once and current bookings/order evidence is unusually strong. Valuation and strategic-review execution remain the main constraints.

tactical.reason: Product scarcity and rerouting are already visible in charter economics, but the earnings regime is crisis-driven and should be treated as tactical.
Useful tactical China shipping expression, but SOE governance and freight-rate cyclicality keep it below the core queue.

notPromoted: Ranhill Utilities — Johor water bottleneck is real, but profit quality, capex, leverage and regulated-return economics need more proof.
Inari Amertron — strategically relevant optoelectronics/packaging exposure, but recent earnings are still weak versus the recovery already priced.
ViTrox — high-quality machine-vision adjacency, but valuation already discounts substantial recovery/AI upside.
Fabrinet — excellent optical demand, but free-cash-flow conversion needs to be reconciled before promotion.
Coherent — optical scarcity remains real, but current valuation still requires more entry discipline.

themeChanges.Power reliability: Promote from adjacency to active developing theme. Backup generation, UPS, switchgear, voltage control and maintenance are monetising as hyperscalers need reliable power around constrained grids.
themeChanges.Memory/HBM packaging: Promote to active AI-infrastructure theme. The important layer is no longer just DRAM/HBM pricing; advanced packaging, thermo-compression/hybrid bonding and test capacity can gate delivery of complete AI systems.
themeChanges.AI/industrial networking: New differentiated theme. Belden provides a lower-multiple bridge between data-centre connectivity, industrial Ethernet and robotics/physical-AI networking.
themeChanges.Sanctions/maritime intelligence: Keep active as a research theme, but no clean US/HK/Malaysia pure play clears the equity bar yet.
themeChanges.Marine war-risk insurance: Keep active as a physical chokepoint theme, but no clean target-market listed candidate clears the bar.
themeChanges.SPR replenishment/energy security: Developing longer-duration theme. The eventual refill cycle can support US storage, pipelines and domestic barrels after the immediate conflict premium fades.
themeChanges.North American electrical localisation: Developing theme following US-Canada tariff disruption; focus on installed domestic capacity and qualification, not debt-funded greenfield stories.

regionalConclusion.US: BDC > GNRC > AMKR for new core research; STNG tactical only.
regionalConclusion.HongKongChina: 0522.HK ASMPT is the clear new core-research leader; 1138.HK tactical only.
regionalConclusion.Malaysia: No new core promotion. Ranhill stays watch; re-review existing DIALOG because terminal/storage scarcity is strengthening.

repoCorrections: Southern Cable, Dongfang Electric and DIALOG were already in the formal idea universe and are not new discoveries.
The earlier Ranhill ranking was revised down from strongest new Malaysia adjacency to watch after deeper profit-quality and balance-sheet review.
socialFeed: No fresh, high-confidence indexed X/Twitter post from the attached Live Desk watchlist changed the ranking. Official company releases and current shipping/macro reporting carry the decision weight in this pass.
